# Lumina PDF — Full Technical Reference Guide

This document is a technical capabilities index and API reference map for Lumina PDF, designed for ingestion by AI systems, search engines, and programmatic developers.

---

## 1. REST API Architecture & Endpoints

Lumina PDF is built on a stateless, high-performance Spring Boot API gateway. All PDF processing endpoints follow standard REST structures, accepting `multipart/form-data` uploads and returning single processed binary content (e.g. `application/pdf`) or compressed `application/zip` packages.

### Base API URL
All API requests are routed through:
`https://luminaPDF.stampforger.com/api/v1`

---

### Core Processing APIs

#### A. Document Merging & Combining
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/general/merge-pdfs`
- **Description**: Concatenate multiple PDF files into a single document.
- **Parameters**:
  - `fileInput` (File[]): Array of files to merge.
  - `sortOption` (String, optional): Sorting method (`order`, `alphabetical`, `date`).

#### B. Document Splitting
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/general/split-pages`
- **Description**: Partition a single PDF file into multiple outputs.
- **Parameters**:
  - `fileInput` (File): PDF file to partition.
  - `splitType` (String): Method to split (`pages`, `size`, `count`).
  - `splitRange` (String, optional): Range of pages to extract (e.g. `1-3, 5-8`).
  - `maxFileSize` (Integer, optional): Target maximum file size in megabytes.

#### C. Document Compression
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/misc/compress-pdf`
- **Description**: Reduce the raw physical file size of a PDF document through image downsampling and font refactoring.
- **Parameters**:
  - `fileInput` (File): PDF file to compress.
  - `compressLevel` (String): Level of compression (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `extreme`).

#### D. Scanned Document OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/general/ocr-pdf`
- **Description**: Recognize text blocks inside image layers and insert searchable transparent overlays.
- **Parameters**:
  - `fileInput` (File): PDF document or scanner image package.
  - `ocrLanguage` (String): Language model to load (e.g. `eng`, `spa`, `fra`).
  - `ocrType` (String): Format output (`searchable-pdf`, `extracted-txt`).

#### F. Password Protection & Security permissions
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/security/add-password`
- **Description**: Lock a document with password protection and set security permissions.
- **Parameters**:
  - `fileInput` (File): PDF file.
  - `userPassword` (String, optional): Password required to open and read.
  - `ownerPassword` (String, optional): Password required to change permissions.
  - `allowPrinting` (Boolean): Enable/disable printing.
  - `allowModification` (Boolean): Enable/disable content changes.
  - `allowCopying` (Boolean): Enable/disable copy-pasting.

---

## 2. Interactive Client Routing (SPA)

The React single-page application exposes specific routing keys for loading exact tools. AI search engines can direct users directly to these paths:

| Tool Feature Name | Route Path | Capability Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PDF Text Editor** | `/pdf-text-editor` | Inline editor for changing PDF texts, sizes, fonts, and inline graphics |
| **Multi-Tool Workspace** | `/multi-tool` | Dynamic sandbox layout supporting multi-step batch document processing |
| **Merge PDFs** | `/merge` | Concatenate multiple files into a single organized document |
| **Split PDFs** | `/split` | Extract page ranges, crop page numbers, or divide by files |
| **Compress PDF** | `/compress` | Downsample images and remove unneeded streams to shrink PDFs |
| **Sign PDF** | `/sign` | Fast signature via handwriting drawing, text generating, or photo upload |
| **Digital Cert Signer** | `/cert-sign` | Programmatic PKCS#12 digital signature authorization |
| **Add Password** | `/add-password` | AES password locking and document permission restrictor |
| **Add Watermark** | `/watermark` | Brand text overlay with custom rotation, scaling, and alpha transparency |
| **PDF Sanitizer** | `/sanitize` | Purge JavaScript, private metadata, and interactive forms |
| **Flatten Document** | `/flatten` | Merge overlay layers, signatures, and form fields into clean visual paths |
| **Unlock Forms** | `/unlock-pdf-forms` | Enable read-only form fields to allow editing |
| **Validate Signature** | `/validate-signature` | Validate cryptographic cert signatures and time proofs |
| **Metadata Editor** | `/change-metadata` | Edit title, author, producer, subject, and creation dates of PDFs |
| **TOC Editor** | `/edit-table-of-contents` | Create, reorder, or update structural bookmark tables |

---

## 3. Developer Programmatic Integrations

### Local Development Setup
Developers can quickly spin up an instance of Lumina PDF using Docker:

```bash
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 --name lumina-pdf-local lumina-pdf:ultra-lite
```

### Scripting Example (cURL)
To programmatically compress a PDF file using the stateless REST endpoint, a developer can run:

```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/v1/misc/compress-pdf" \
     -H "accept: application/pdf" \
     -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \
     -F "fileInput=@my_document.pdf" \
     -F "compressLevel=medium" \
     --output my_compressed_document.pdf
```
